## `BMEcatPdf_GW` / `MCPcatPdf_GW` (full logic)

Both wrappers share the same structure: loop over estimation points, blend a local model, isotropize XY, then call the stationary estimator once per point with `dmax=None`.

```494:567:/Users/hdragon689/Documents/MyDoc_iCloud/packages/stamps/stamps_v3/stamps/stamps/stats/dependence/gw_pmodel.py
def BMEcatPdf_GW(ck, cs, ps, gw_pmodel, nsmax, options=None, verbose=False):
    """Nonstationary BMEcatPdf using a Geographically Weighted Pmodel.
    ...
    """
    from ...bme.BMEcatPdf import BMEcatPdf

    ck = np.asarray(ck, dtype=float)
    cs = np.asarray(cs, dtype=float)
    ps = np.asarray(ps, dtype=float)
    if options is None:
        options = {}
    nk = ck.shape[0]
    nc = gw_pmodel.nc
    pk = np.full((nk, nc), np.nan)

    for i in range(nk):
        xy_i = ck[i, :2]
        (dm_h, Pm_h, dm_v, Pm_v,
         theta_eff, r_eff, p_marg) = gw_pmodel.blend_at(xy_i)

        # Transform horizontal coordinates to local isotropic space
        cs_xy_iso = aniso2iso(cs[:, :2], theta_eff, max(r_eff, 0.05))
        ck_xy_iso = aniso2iso(ck[i:i+1, :2], theta_eff, max(r_eff, 0.05))
        cs_iso = np.hstack([cs_xy_iso, cs[:, 2:3]])
        ck_iso = np.hstack([ck_xy_iso, ck[i:i+1, 2:3]])

        # Build per-point separable model
        dmodel_list = [dm_h, dm_v]
        Pmodel_list = [Pm_h, Pm_v]

        opts_i = {**options, 'p_marginal': p_marg}

        try:
            pk_i = BMEcatPdf(
                ck_iso, cs_iso, ps,
                dmodel_list, Pmodel_list,
                nsmax, None, options=opts_i)
            pk[i, :] = pk_i[0, :]
        except Exception:
            pk[i, :] = p_marg

        if verbose and (i + 1) % max(1, nk // 10) == 0:
            print(f'  BMEcatPdf_GW: {i+1}/{nk}')

    return pk
```
